commit 7e443f78f67c66634b8256d6759653dd9c2c0329
Author:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Aug 27 12:36:59 2024 +0200
Commit:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Tue Aug 27 12:36:59 2024 +0200

    Bug 1915253 - Fix more wrongly stated null / undefined return values in the schema files. r=aleca
    
    This patch is not introducing a functional change.
    
    * accounts.get() in Manifest V3 stated in the description, that `null` can be returned, but did not specify it in the actual return type definition.
    * Some functions had "This may return undefined" as description in the return type definition, which is moved into the main description and  made more specific.
    * The `MailFolder` definition is split now for Manifest V2 and Manifest V3. In Manifest V3 most properties are no longer defined as optional. They were defined as optional in Manifest V2 because the `MailFolder` was used as a function parameter and we allowed to specify only `accountId` and `path`. In Manifest V3 function parameters only use the new `MailFolderId`.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D220336
